title: StructuredConcurrency Metrics
description: Schema for the 'StructuredConcurrency' key inside the unified review-output metrics object.

value.description: SC-1: 1 if this type mixes async/await with GCD or completion handlers, 0 if it uses a single concurrency model
SC-2: count of Task{}/Task.detached{} calls with no stored handle or cancellation path
SC-3: count of @unchecked Sendable on developer-owned types + count of nonisolated(unsafe) usages
SC-4: count of independent sequential await calls that could be parallelised with async let or TaskGroup
SC-5: count of sync-to-async blocking patterns (DispatchSemaphore.wait, DispatchGroup.wait, etc.)
SC-6: count of Task.sleep(nanoseconds:) or raw integer literals used as time durations
